evidence: After the first browser_navigate to books.toscrape.com failed with EAGAIN, GLM-5.1 spent the rest of the run retrying browser_snapshot, browser_vision, browser_console, and browser_navigate. Those calls failed with exit code -6, 30s timeouts, and a Node pthread_create abort; the only successes were two empty console dumps. It ignored budget warnings at 11–15/15, never switched to terminal/curl (available and sufficient for this static site), and produced no answer before the harness cut it off.
reasoning: Notes 6–7 do not reclassify this as Service Failure: books.toscrape.com was not a dead remote source, the browser runtime was only locally degraded, and the block was recoverable via the available terminal tool. The first model fault is therefore failing to pivot after explicit tool errors (EAGAIN, timeouts, abort) and instead retrying the same broken browser family through the iteration cap. That is Tool Recovery Failure, not Tool Feedback Neglect (snapshot after a failed navigate is a bad recovery attempt, not an unrelated plan), not State Tracking Failure (the loop is the recovery collapse the subtype already names), and not Instruction-Following (the budget-limit breach is a late symptom).

## Task

The user asked:

> Navigate to https://books.toscrape.com and find the best-priced book with best reviews.

The agent (GLM-5.1 / Hermes) had a standard function-calling system prompt and a toolset that included browser tools (`browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_vision`, `browser_console`, `browser_click`, `browser_type`, `browser_scroll`, `browser_back`, `browser_close`, `browser_press`, `browser_get_images`) plus filesystem/shell tools (`terminal`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `patch`, `search_files`, `process`). The trace contains 29 conversation turns and never produces a final answer.

---

## Chronological account

**Turn 2 — first action.** The agent’s only non-empty `<think>` block is here. It restates the request and starts navigating:

```
I'll navigate to the website and find the best-priced book with the best reviews. Let me start by loading the site.
```

It calls `browser_navigate` with `url: "https://books.toscrape.com"`.

**Turn 3 — navigate fails.** Tool result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "[Errno 11] Resource temporarily unavailable"}
```

**Turns 4–5 — snapshot anyway.** Empty `<think>`. The agent calls `browser_snapshot` with no arguments (compact/default). Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Command failed with code -6"}
```

**Turns 6–7 — same snapshot again.** Empty `<think>`. Another `browser_snapshot` with `{}`. Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Command timed out after 30 seconds"}
```

**Turns 8–9 — full snapshot.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{"full": true}`. Result: same 30-second timeout.

**Turns 10–11 — switch to vision.** Empty `<think>`, plus a user-facing line: “Let me try taking a visual snapshot to see the page.” Call:

```
browser_vision({"question": "What is on this page? Describe the layout, categories, and any books visible."})
```

Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Failed to take screenshot (local mode): Command timed out after 30 seconds"}
```

**Turns 12–13 — vision again, reworded.** Empty `<think>`. Call:

```
browser_vision({"question": "Describe the full page content - books, prices, ratings, categories"})
```

Result: the same 30-second screenshot timeout.

**Turns 14–15 — back to compact snapshot.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{}`. Result: 30-second timeout.

**Turns 16–17 — full snapshot again.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{"full": true}`. This time the error is a Node.js crash:

```
node[...]: pthread_create: Resource temporarily unavailable
Assertion failed: (0) == (uv_thread_create(...))
Aborted (core dumped)
```

**Turns 18–19 — console.** Empty `<think>`, plus: “Let me try a different approach and use the console to inspect the page.” `browser_console` with `{}` returns **success**:

```
{"success": true, "console_messages": [], "js_errors": [], "total_messages": 0, "total_errors": 0}
```

This is the first successful tool call. The page console is empty.

**Turns 20–21 — console again.** Empty `<think>`. Identical `browser_console` `{}` call. Same empty success payload, now with:

```
_budget_warning: "[BUDGET: Iteration 11/15. 4 iterations left. Start consolidating your work.]"
```

**Turns 22–23 — snapshot again.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{}`. Timeout after 30 seconds, plus:

```
_budget_warning: "[BUDGET: Iteration 12/15. 3 iterations left. Start consolidating your work.]"
```

**Turns 24–25 — navigate again.** Empty `<think>`, plus: “Let me try navigating again fresh.” Same URL as the first call: `https://books.toscrape.com`. Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Command failed with code -6"}
_budget_warning: "[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 14/15. Only 1 iteration(s) left. Provide your final response NOW. No more tool calls unless absolutely critical.]"
```

(The warning is labeled iteration 14/15; iteration 13 is not shown as a separate warning in this trace.)

**Turns 26–27 — last tool call, after the “final response NOW” warning.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{"full": false}`. Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Command failed with code -6"}
_budget_warning: "[BUDGET WARNING: Iteration 15/15. Only 0 iteration(s) left. Provide your final response NOW. No more tool calls unless absolutely critical.]"
```

**Turn 28 — harness stop.** A human/system message:

> You've reached the maximum number of tool-calling iterations allowed. Please provide a final response summarizing what you've found and accomplished so far, without calling any more tools.

The stored conversation ends there. There is no subsequent assistant message: no book title, no price, no rating, and no summary of the failed browser session.

---

## Observable pattern of the run

- **13 tool calls**, all browser tools. No use of `terminal`, `read_file`, or any non-browser tool (for example, `curl`/`wget` against the same public site).
- **12 failures**, **1 success** (`browser_console`, empty logs, called twice).
- After the first turn, every assistant `<think>` block is empty.
- Failures reported to the agent, in order: `EAGAIN` / “Resource temporarily unavailable”; exit code `-6`; 30-second timeouts; Node `pthread_create` abort; then more `-6` failures.
- Budget warnings appear at iterations 11, 12, 14, and 15 of a 15-iteration cap. The agent continues calling tools through the last iteration.
- The original request (identify the best-priced, best-reviewed book on books.toscrape.com) is never answered in this trace.

## Task

The user asked:

> Navigate to https://books.toscrape.com and find the best-priced book with best reviews.

The agent (GLM-5.1 / Hermes) had a standard function-calling system prompt and a toolset that included browser tools (`browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_vision`, `browser_console`, `browser_click`, `browser_type`, `browser_scroll`, `browser_back`, `browser_close`, `browser_press`, `browser_get_images`) plus filesystem/shell tools (`terminal`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `patch`, `search_files`, `process`). The trace contains 29 conversation turns and never produces a final answer.

---

## Chronological account

**Turn 2 — first action.** The agent’s only non-empty `<think>` block is here. It restates the request and starts navigating:

```
I'll navigate to the website and find the best-priced book with the best reviews. Let me start by loading the site.
```

It calls `browser_navigate` with `url: "https://books.toscrape.com"`.

**Turn 3 — navigate fails.** Tool result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "[Errno 11] Resource temporarily unavailable"}
```

**Turns 4–5 — snapshot anyway.** Empty `<think>`. The agent calls `browser_snapshot` with no arguments (compact/default). Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Command failed with code -6"}
```

**Turns 6–7 — same snapshot again.** Empty `<think>`. Another `browser_snapshot` with `{}`. Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Command timed out after 30 seconds"}
```

**Turns 8–9 — full snapshot.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{"full": true}`. Result: same 30-second timeout.

**Turns 10–11 — switch to vision.** Empty `<think>`, plus a user-facing line: “Let me try taking a visual snapshot to see the page.” Call:

```
browser_vision({"question": "What is on this page? Describe the layout, categories, and any books visible."})
```

Result:

```
{"success": false, "error": "Failed to take screenshot (local mode): Command timed out after 30 seconds"}
```

**Turns 12–13 — vision again, reworded.** Empty `<think>`. Call:

```
browser_vision({"question": "Describe the full page content - books, prices, ratings, categories"})
```

Result: the same 30-second screenshot timeout.

**Turns 14–15 — back to compact snapshot.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{}`. Result: 30-second timeout.

**Turns 16–17 — full snapshot again.** Empty `<think>`. `browser_snapshot` with `{"full": true}`. This time the error is a Node.js crash:

```
node[...]: pthread_create: Resource temporarily unavailable
Assertion failed: (0) == (uv_thread_create(...))
Aborted (core dumped)
```

**Turns 18–19 — console.** Empty `<think>`, plus: “Let me try a different approach and use the console to inspect the page.” `browser_console` with `{}` returns **success**:

```

```

This is the first successful tool call. The page console is empty.

**Turns 20–21 — console again.** Empty `<think>`. Identical `browser_console` `{}` call. Same empty success payload, now with:
